knowledge_gaps: The report does not quantify terminal-mask exposure in the supplied baseline or isolate the effects of terminal weighting, recent-prefix sampling, and the curriculum. Originality 3/10 is reasonable; potential 7/10 remains speculative.

Reproduction requires explicit cutoff bounds and quartile rounding, short-history handling, reconstruction masking probabilities, real-item softmax vocabulary, and checkpoint-selection rules. Padding and MASK must be excluded from candidate targets.
Two training forwards and full-catalog cross-entropy may materially increase GPU time and memory. Difficulty 2/10 lacks a cost estimate under the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget.

Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category can overfit the fixed sample. No validation HR@10 baseline, paired uncertainty analysis, or budgeted ablation plan is supplied. Pairwise training margins cannot establish terminal ranking improvements, and mean cosine similarity alone cannot exclude other forms of representation collapse.
